verdict.rationale: telli's agent builder has a Test call dialog that lets developers try a draft (including unsaved changes) or any saved revision before deployment, then review the recording alongside the transcript. This is manual pre-production testing. There is no evidence of automated simulated conversations, test suites, or eval scoring. missing for 10: automated simulated-caller/persona conversations, eval or regression test suites with pass/fail scoring, programmatic (API) test runs, independent hands-on corroboration.
